operations.description:
Confirms a previously submitted payout.

To cancel a payout, use the `/declineThirdParty` endpoint.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] confirm third party [PATH] confirm third party [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] modify request response

operations.description:
Cancels a previously submitted payout.

To confirm and send a payout, use the `/confirmThirdParty` endpoint.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] decline third party [PATH] decline third party [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] modify request response

operations.description: With this call, you can pay out to your customers, and funds will be made available within 30 minutes on the cardholder's bank account (this is dependent on whether the issuer supports this functionality). Instant card payouts are only supported for Visa and Mastercard cards.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] payout [PATH] payout [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] 3 additional address amount billing card check common data domestic dsecure error fraud fund installments name network opi payout recurring request response result sepa source tokens wrapper

operations.description: Stores payment details under the `PAYOUT` recurring contract. These payment details can be used later to submit a payout via the `/submitThirdParty` call.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] store detail [PATH] store detail [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] account address bank card detail name recurring request response store

operations.description:
Submits a payout and stores its details for subsequent payouts.

The submitted payout must be confirmed or declined either by a reviewer or via `/confirmThirdParty` or `/declineThirdParty` calls.
operations.summary: Store details and submit a payout
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] store detail and submit third party [PATH] store detail and submit third party [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] account address amount and bank card detail name recurring request response store submit

operations.description:
Submits a payout using the previously stored payment details. To store payment details, use the `/storeDetail` API call.

The submitted payout must be confirmed or declined either by a reviewer or via `/confirmThirdParty` or `/declineThirdParty` calls.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] submit third party [PATH] submit third party [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] amount name recurring request response submit
